title: Light Mediterranean Sweetcorn Salad
description: A refreshing and light salad perfect for a warm summer night. This dish combines the sweetness of corn with the tanginess of feta and a hint of bitterness from the arugula.
instructions: In a sous-vide machine, cook the sweetcorn for 1 hour at 170°F (77°C).
Chop the cooked sweetcorn into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the arugula, chopped sweetcorn, feta cheese, red onion, and olives.
Drizzle the olive oil and lemon juice over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir the salad and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
Garnish with additional feta cheese and arugula if desired.
